evidence.marks: experimental: ENCODE Histone ChIP-seq (GRCh38, default analysis), replicated peaks overlapping the locus
evidence.promoters: TSS +/- 1 kb; read or silent by the DNase reader (inferred)
evidence.methylation: experimental: ENCODE WGBS, methylation state at CpG (GRCh38 bedMethyl), calls with 5+ reads, promoters with 4+
evidence.state: inferred: fixed rules over the five measured marks' peak calls (bivalent, active promoter, active enhancer, poised or primed enhancer, Polycomb, heterochromatin); not a ChromHMM model
